content.study:
Maintenance historically concerns officious intermeddling in another's litigation; champerty is maintenance coupled with an agreement for a share of the proceeds. Indian law does not treat every champertous agreement as automatically void.\
\
Ram Coomar Coondoo v Chunder Canto Mookerjee established that English rules of maintenance and champerty were not adopted as automatic prohibitions in India. Rattan Chand Hira Chand v Askar Nawaz Jung later confirmed that such agreements are not per se void, while public policy and unconscionability remain relevant.
